mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_records (user_id, login_time, ip_address) VALUES (#{userId}, NOW(), #{ipAddress})
mapper.select: SELECT lr.user_id, u.username, lr.login_time, lr.ip_address FROM login_records lr LEFT JOIN member u ON lr.user_id = u.id WHERE lr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY lr.login_time DESC LIMIT 30
